operational_threat_assumption: Root-owned 0700 quarantines and explicit privileged/adversarial mutation, reference acquisition, and reference-transfer exclusion are operational controls during observation AND deletion, not an atomic global proof.
mechanical_finalization: Independently review and fetch the corrected observer; replace only OBSERVER_SHA_REQUIRED with its fetched SHA256.
Commit, push, and fetch the exact packet, wrapper, basis, and test; bind their final hashes and the fetched source commit in a new PASS basis.
Obtain a separate root execution release binding the final basis, packet, wrapper, test, observer, raw archive, and v2 authorities.
A release may run exactly once. Failure retains claim/journal/evidence and never retries, rolls back, renames roots, or changes the historical tombstone.
